description:
Coverage scope: ONLY lib/zaq/engine/actions/save_email_connector.ex:33, the run(_, _) catch-all returning {:error, :unauthorized}. Exclusive test edit path: test/zaq/engine/workflows/actions/connector_action_schema_test.exs. Do not edit other files or introduce production hooks.

Test-first steps:
1. Add a focused ExUnit test in the existing async: true module directly invoking SaveEmailConnector.run/2. For invalid params, pair representative non-map values nil, [], and "invalid" with a map context %{}; assert EXACTLY {:error, :unauthorized} for each. For invalid context, pair the existing valid @save_params map with nil, [], and "invalid" as context; assert the same exact tuple. Optionally assert the both-non-map case once if branch reporting requests it. Both guard-failure directions execute line 33; do not treat rejected Jido.Exec.run/3 calls as proof of line coverage because Zoi/Jido may reject before entering run/2.
2. No BO actor, database, provider, encryption key, runtime sync, or network fixture is required: the fallback guard returns before BOActor.current_user/1 or EmailConnectorSettings.save/2. Reuse the existing SaveEmailConnector alias and @save_params fixture; no mocks/Mox, setup, sandbox or global state mutations. Keep async: true and avoid sleeps. Assert exact returned tuple; no private-call assertions. Existing schema/authorization tests remain intact.
3. Explicit blocker: malformed arguments cannot be relied on to reach run/2 via the public Jido.Exec.run/3 validated entry, because input schema and wrapper checks may short-circuit; direct callback invocation is the appropriate unit seam for this defensive guard. If a requirement forbids direct callback testing, mark line 33 unreachable through the supported Exec path and request review rather than modifying production or weakening schema. This is no product feature and needs no new E2E/UX approval.
4. Property assessment: finite, type-guard defensive branch with a single invariant return and representative equivalence classes; examples suffice. Existing property test covers required Action fields. Do not add random generators merely to drive a simple guard. If review demands broad-term coverage, add a bounded non-map generator property in this same path, excluding maps and asserting exact unauthorized return; it is not necessary for the target line.
5. Implementation-phase validation only (NOT performed in this planning task): isolated mix test test/zaq/engine/workflows/actions/connector_action_schema_test.exs, then mix q through Context Mode; inspect fresh coverage for lib/zaq/engine/actions/save_email_connector.ex:33 in the authorized coverage phase (fresh mix coveralls.json followed by mix coverup only on success); review diff and record exceptions in this issue. Final mix precommit only at final human-approval gate per workflow. No operations change: Action reuse gate not applicable; existing Action and test surface only.
